notes.title: Welcome to the Afterlife!
notes.notes:
Ever wondered what it’s like to be the gatekeeper of the Afterlife? Sorting the dead between Heaven and Hell sounds simple, right? Well, get ready to juggle mountains of paperwork, holy texts, and the pleas of desperate Souls—all while trying to keep your own fate from taking a turn for the worse.

Inspired by Papers, Please, Elevator Down throws you into the bureaucratic madness of the Afterlife’s Life Evaluation Department. Will you stick to the strict religious guidelines, or let your moral compass guide your decisions? Just remember, every choice counts, and one wrong move could have eternal consequences… for you!

[previewyoutube=BHXDTJgeeVU;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you’re ready for a satirical, thought-provoking journey through the Afterlife with our signature brand of humour. Whether you play by the rules or blaze your own trail, Elevator Down will challenge your judgment and keep you on your toes.

So what are you waiting for? Wishlist already!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866290/Elevator_Down/

The game is still under heavy development, which means everything can change at any time! Share your wild ideas and feedback, maybe we can manage to implement them in some way!

Thank you for joining us on this adventure—we can’t wait to hear what you think!
~eNVy softworks
